headline.purpose: Page titles on builder and fetch.

shadows.name: print-well
shadows.purpose: Only on .printout: a hairline ledge plus a tight dark well.

motion.name: ease-control
motion.purpose: Border, background, and color on buttons and chips.

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Paper fill, hairline stroke. Hover dusts the border.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.45rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #3a342c); background: var(--paper, #1c1814); color: var(--fg, #ece6d8); font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; transition: border-color 120ms ease, background 120ms ease; } .ds-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--muted, #8a8376); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #c45c26); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Copper fill, walnut text. The one publish/create action in a cluster.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.45rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #c45c26); background: var(--accent, #c45c26); color: var(--bg, #14110f); font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; transition: filter 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #c45c26); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Transparent facet. Active is copper stroke and text, never a fill.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #3a342c); color: var(--fg, #ece6d8); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; transition: border-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--muted, #8a8376); } .ds-chip[data-active="true"] { border-color: var(--accent, #c45c26); color: var(--accent, #c45c26); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #c45c26); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-count { color: var(--muted, #8a8376); }

components.name: Field
components.description: Walnut well, mono 13px. Focus recolors the hairline to copper.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-q">Search title or handle</label><input id="ds-q" class="ds-field" placeholder="hyprland, moth, minimal" />
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.3rem; color: var(--muted, #8a8376); font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field { width: 100%; padding: 0.5rem 0.65rem; background: var(--bg, #14110f); border: 1px solid var(--border, #3a342c); color: var(--fg, #ece6d8); font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 13px; border-radius: 0; } .ds-field:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #c45c26); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #c45c26); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #8a8376); opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Printout
components.description: The signature sheet: paper fill, hairline, print-well shadow, keyed rows.
components.css: .ds-printout { background: var(--paper, #1c1814); border: 1px solid var(--border, #3a342c); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--border, #3a342c), 0 12px 32px -20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); padding: 16px; color: var(--fg, #ece6d8); font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 0; } .ds-printout-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 7.5rem 1fr; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.45rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #3a342c); margin: 0; } .ds-printout-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-printout-row dt { color: var(--muted, #8a8376); margin: 0; } .ds-printout-row dd { margin: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-kind { display: inline-block; padding: 0 0.35rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #3a342c); color: var(--muted, #8a8376); font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Site Header
components.description: 48px chrome bar. Mono wordmark with 8px copper square; Create fetch is the only primary.
components.html:
sharefetch
HomeExploreCreate fetch
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #3a342c); background: var(--bg, #14110f); font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.25rem; font-size: 14px; } .ds-mark { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fg, #ece6d8); text-decoration: none; } .ds-sq { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--accent, #c45c26); margin-right: 8px; vertical-align: middle; } .ds-link { color: var(--muted, #8a8376); text-decoration: none; } .ds-link:hover { color: var(--fg, #ece6d8); } .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.45rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #c45c26); background: var(--accent, #c45c26); color: var(--bg, #14110f); font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Kind Cue
components.description: Boxed WM / DE / CMP. Letters distinguish kind; color does not.
components.css: .ds-kind-cue { display: inline-block; padding: 0 0.35rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #3a342c); color: var(--muted, #8a8376); font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.5; vertical-align: middle; border-radius: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Sharefetch looks like a warm terminal that just printed a fetch card. The page is walnut (#14110f); every claim about a stack sits on a slightly lifted paper (#1c1814) with a 1px hairline. Copper (#c45c26) is not a brand wash. It is the cursor: the header square, the SVG corner ticks, the primary publish action, the active facet, the focus ring.

IBM Plex Mono is the reading voice because a fetch is typed data. IBM Plex Sans is chrome only: nav, buttons, uppercase labels, the footer. The two faces never swap roles.

Embed themes (dracula, gruvbox, nord, and the rest) recolor the SVG card, never the site. Site chrome stays this walnut system so a README screenshot of the product still matches the product.
keyCharacteristics: Square corners everywhere. Radius is a defect.
Hairline borders (#3a342c), not shadows as the default depth cue.
Copper used as a rare signal, not a fill.
Mono body, sans chrome. Uppercase tracked labels.
The printout (card / builder section / live preview frame) is the signature silhouette.

rules.name: The Rare Copper Rule
rules.body: Copper occupies a small fraction of any screen. Filling a printout, a sidebar, or a hero with accent is a different product.

rules.name: The Site Is Not the Theme Rule
rules.body: spec.theme only paints the embed. Do not restyle body from an embed theme.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: .chrome (and .label, .btn, .kind-cue) is Sans. Everything that is a value — titles, fields, JSON, printout dd — is Mono.

rules.name: The Printout-Only Lift Rule
rules.body: If it is not a fetch card, a builder section, or the live preview frame, it stays flush with the ground.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: Radius is 0. Buttons, chips, fields, printouts, kind cues, the header mark: all rectangles.

dos: Do put claims (stacks, live SVG, JSON, paste) inside a printout.
Do keep copper rare: one primary action per cluster, active chips, focus, the square mark.
Do use uppercase tracked eyebrows and labels for shell; sentence case for titles and values.
Do keep embed theme switching on the card, not on body.
donts: Don't round corners, add glass, neon, or a second saturated hue in chrome.
Don't set body in Plex Sans or labels in a third family.
Don't fill chips or kind cues with copper.
Don't restyle the app from Catppuccin/Nord/etc. Those are card skins.
Don't replace the copper squares with logos, gradients, or status dots.
